biggest_catch: The $50 comes as a Visa Reward Card (not cash) and takes 4-6 weeks to arrive after the friend completes the qualifying activities.
catches: Payout is a Visa Reward Card, not cash.
Reward card delivery takes 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed.
Cap: up to $500 per year in referral rewards.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: First Bank & Trust Company's official page (firstbank.com/personal/personal-banking/refer-a-friend/) runs a Customer Referral Program (powered by ReferLive) paying the referrer for qualifying referrals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer earns a $50 Visa Reward Card for each friend who opens a new personal checking account and completes the qualifying activities, up to $500 per year (i.e., 10 paid referrals).

c3.evidence: Mechanism: register at referlive.com/firstbank to receive a unique referral link; share the link via text, email, or social media; the friend registers for the offer, opens a new personal checking account ($50 opening deposit required), and within 60 days enrolls in eStatements and either makes one $500+ direct deposit or makes 10+ debit card transactions (excluding ATMs).

c4.evidence: Timing: the $50 Visa Reward Card is issued after the friend opens the account and completes the qualifying activities; allow 4-6 weeks for delivery.

eligibility: First Bank & Trust Company customers referring friends who open a new personal checking account.
notes: Friend earns the same $50 Visa Reward Card. $500/year cap implies 10 paid referrals.
